Wave 2b, the χ-ledger's divisor-sheaf wave: residue-degree finiteness and positivity at closed points (κ(x) as the chart quotient via localization transport and Jacobson finiteness — the induction gate); principal divisors (the integer-valued order homomorphism on units of the function field with classical sign, divOf with its multiplicativity and finite support via the basic-open unit-germ argument; QuasiCompact added to the hypotheses, documented — finite type alone does not give a Noetherian space); the divisor sheaf O(D) by pole bounds with monotone inclusions and the zero-divisor comparison divisorSheafZeroIso to the structure module sheaf (germ-at-the-generic-point componentwise, surjectivity by the DVR pole-bound stalk lemma and structure-sheaf gluing); and the dévissage tower through S2 — point lattices, the jump module, the projection to the skyscraper — with the short complex, its composition vanishing and the mono leg (S3 partial). RiemannRoch/ResidueDegree, PrincipalDivisor, DivisorSheaf, DivisorSheafZero, Devissage; root build 8664 jobs, keystones axiom-clean. Wave 2b, the dévissage short-exact sequence and the jump dimension: the sequence 0 → O(D−x) → O(D) → skyscraper_x(jump) → 0 is short exact (devissageSES_shortExact — epi via local surjectivity of the projection, excising the finite bad locus and lifting a jump-class representative; middle exactness sectionwise through the pole-lattice/jumpProj equivalence, transported to the sheaf level by limit-reflection), and the jump module is the residue field as a K-space so its dimension is the residue degree (finrank_jumpModule via the uniformizer-shift isomorphism O(D)_x/O(D−x)_x ≅ κ(x) and the first isomorphism theorem). Plus the divisor-sheaf multiplication equivalence mulEquivDivisorSheaf toward the principal-divisor degree identity. G7 closed and G8's multiplication piece landed. Design: (C2) effectivity-campaign recon — the honest remaining content after the G3 correction is a single effectivity brick, the exact dual of the landed (C1) Čech kernel lemma: a rigidified class on the curve over an étale cover whose two double-cover pullbacks agree on the nose descends along the cover inclusion on the curve product. Terrain mapped: the rigidification layer and picEtUnit are landed and hand over the descent equation directly; the section is genuinely needed (class equation ⇒ existence-only comparison; σ-normalization via the landed lm:aut bijectivity supplies the coherence the (C1) side got from its trivialization); the curve product over the cover is NOT affine, so the dictionary and brick-4 descent apply only piece-by-piece on cg-saturated affine opens — and the local-to-global reassembly on curve opens (A4) has no landed primitive, the least-charted step. Five core gaps R0/A1/A2/A3/A4 with (C1)-mirror tags (A2 = the coherent-cochain heart, mirror of exists_coherentCechWitness); Kleiman's Part-2 argument re-read with line anchors and the cocycle-model divergence recorded; Route A (per-piece) vs Route B (global unit) trade-offs left to the worksheet

Design: the (C2) effectivity assembly worksheet — the campaign's route decisions, made and binding. D1: Route A (per-piece descent on cg-saturated affine pieces of the curve product; Route B degenerates — no global unit exists to seed a (C1)-style witness since L is nontrivial on the cover). D2: construct M with TRACKED DESCENT DATA, never class-only — ker(Pic R → Pic S) is Amitsur H¹(S/R,𝔾ₘ), so per-piece classes need not agree on overlaps; what glues is the per-piece descents of the ONE global σ-normalized comparison, unique up to canonical datum-compatible iso, whose canonicity kills the triple-overlap obstruction. D3: reassembly by refinement-splice over an affine basis (pieces don't trivialize M), transition data equal on the nose on overlaps, cg^*M = L by mk-calculus in the constructive direction of the kernel lemma's final assembly. D4: the σ-normalization pinned — extract cochain from the class equation, package the freedom as a global unit, rescale by the projection-pullback of the inverse section-pullback (rigidification makes that unit stateable), then lm:aut kills the triple coboundary; the section replaces (C1)'s upstairs trivialization as the source of coherence. Sub-bricks E0–E4 with delegation (E1 normalization and E3 splice Fable-authored; E0/E2/E4 Opus), staged fallbacks, kernel discipline, acceptance criteria.
